newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Shares in Czech Komercni up after results.
newsitem.headline: Shares in Czech Komercni up after results.

text.p: Shares in the largest Czech commercial bank, Komercni Banka a.s., rose at midday on Friday after the company released nine month profit figures which were lower but within the range of dealers' expectations.
At 1115 GMT, Komercni's shares on the Prague bourse were up 55 crowns on the day to 2,055 and dealers quoted Komercni at 2,055/75 on the over-the-counter (OTC) market.
Earlier on Friday Komercni posted nine month net profits of 4.8 billion crowns compared with 5.4 billion in the same period in 1995.
"But you can't exactly compare last year's with this year's results because they have changed some accounting (procedures)," said Karel Ruzicka of ING Barings.
Ruzicka said the results were in line with expectations and partly attrubuted Komercni's share price rise to demand from foreign investors.
"Some of the foreign investors are familiar with the results and they think they are not so bad therefore we can see some demand in the stock," he said.
